articles.title_en: Mapping and prioritising landscape feature restoration in agricultural landscapes: A case study in Brandenburg, Germany
articles.title_cn: 农业景观中景观特征恢复的绘图与优先排序：德国勃兰登堡案例研究
articles.abstract_en: EU agricultural landscapes are vital for biodiversity. Intensive agricultural practices constitute, however, key drivers of biodiversity loss. The EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 aims to restore “at least 10 % of agricultural area under high-diversity landscape features”, yet it lacks specific guidance for assessment and implementation. Here, we develop an approach to (a) map and assess agricultural landscape features (LF) cover at a landscape scale, (b) cluster agricultural landscapes by complexity using both compositional and configurational heterogeneity metrics, and (c) prioritise landscapes and sites for LF restoration by targeting areas of lower productivity and higher erosion risk, to enhance farmer acceptance and increase restoration benefits. Using Brandenburg, Germany, as a case study, we found that 94.4 % of landscapes fall short of the 10 % landscape features cover target. We categorised five agricultural landscape types ranging from simple to complex mosaics. At the local scale, in ten randomly selected landscapes, we identified an additional 11 % of agricultural areas on which LF could be restored. Our study helps advance methodologies to prioritise LF restoration. It can provide guidance for administrators and planners to assess the LF status and advance their adoption by farmers. We recommend prioritising landscapes and selecting restoration actions based on overall landscape complexity assessment. At the local scale, we recommend participatory processes involving local stakeholders. We believe our methodology is transferable to other EU regions, and highlights both the opportunities and challenges in developing a standardised, EU-wide approach for prioritising LF restoration to support agroecological transitions in Europe.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟农业景观对生物多样性至关重要。然而，集约化农业实践是生物多样性丧失的关键驱动因素。欧盟生物多样性战略2030旨在恢复“至少10%的农业面积，使其具有高多样性景观特征”，但缺乏评估和实施的具体指导。在此，我们开发了一种方法，用于(a)在景观尺度上绘制和评估农业景观特征(LF)覆盖度，(b)使用组成和配置异质性指标，按复杂性对农业景观进行聚类，以及(c)通过瞄准生产力较低和侵蚀风险较高的区域，优先考虑景观和地点进行LF恢复，以提高农民接受度并增加恢复效益。以德国勃兰登堡为案例研究，我们发现94.4%的景观未达到10%的景观特征覆盖目标。我们将五种农业景观类型从简单到复杂的镶嵌体进行了分类。在局部尺度上，在十个随机选择的景观中，我们确定了额外的11%的农业区域，在这些区域可以恢复LF。我们的研究有助于推进LF恢复优先排序的方法。它可以为管理者和规划者提供评估LF状况并推进农民采纳的指导。我们建议基于整体景观复杂性评估，优先考虑景观并选择恢复行动。在局部尺度上，我们建议涉及当地利益相关者的参与式过程。我们相信我们的方法可转移到其他欧盟地区，并强调了在制定标准化、欧盟范围内LF恢复优先排序方法以支持欧洲农业生态转型方面的机遇和挑战。

articles.title_en: The diffusion of digital technologies in landscape planning – A scoping literature review
articles.title_cn: 数字技术在景观规划中的扩散——一项范围界定文献综述
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates digital technologies (DT) in landscape planning (LP). The aim, was to systematically map and assess the degree of use of digital technologies in, landscape planning as well as propose guidance for further research, We performed a scoping review of 53,114 papers published from January 2012 until, May 2023. We followed the PRISMA-ScR framework, combined with semi-automated, data charting and bibliometric analysis. This approach allowed us to identify and, classify relevant literature, technology trends, and correlations between different DT.The algorithms we developed can be used to monitor DT in LP. By comprehensive, analysis, we identified trends and their dynamics over the last decade, the direction of technological evolution, and correlations between the technologies. We identified 35 technologies, which we grouped into 12 categories: Remote Sensing (RS); Geographical Information Systems (GIS); Other Digital Modelling (mathematical and statistical); Artificial Intelligence Related (AI-Related); Information and Communication Technologies (ICT); 3D Modelling; Data; Decision Support Systems (DSS); Robotic; Virtual Reality/Augmented Reality/Mixed Reality (VR/AR/MR); Social Media; and Computer Aided Design (CAD). Our analysis revealed that only a few are currently integral to the planning process (RS, GIS, Other Digital Modelling, AI-Related, and 3D Modelling), whereas others, such as AI and data technologies, now rapidly evolving, have started to expand their application. Machine Learning (ML) and RS are the most dynamically growing technologies while emerging technologies include Other ICT, BIM, VR/AR/MR, and Social Media. The most prominent reciprocal correlation is between Data – RS – AIRelated. This study's significance lies in its comprehensive mapping of digital technologies in landscape planning, which provides valuable insights for planners, policymakers, and researchers. Major conclusions reveal that more knowledge of technologies explicitly targeting the LP is needed, including understanding and associating their feasibility and application for different process phases and smooth overall workflow. While our scoping literature review provided comprehensive information on DT for the LP process, the next step is developing practical toolboxes
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了景观规划（LP）中的数字技术（DT）。目的是系统性地绘制和评估数字技术在景观规划中的使用程度，并为进一步研究提出指导。我们对从2012年一月至2023年五月发表的53,114篇论文进行了范围界定综述。我们遵循PRISMA-ScR框架，结合半自动数据图表和文献计量分析。这种方法使我们能够识别和分类相关文献、技术趋势以及不同DT之间的相关性。我们开发的算法可用于监测LP中的DT。通过全面分析，我们识别了过去十年的趋势及其动态、技术演进方向以及技术之间的相关性。我们识别出35种技术，并将其归为12类：遥感（RS）；地理信息系统（GIS）；其他数字建模（数学和统计）；人工智能相关（AI相关）；信息与通信技术（ICT）；三维建模；数据；决策支持系统（DSS）；机器人技术；虚拟现实/增强现实/混合现实（VR/AR/MR）；社交媒体；以及计算机辅助设计（CAD）。我们的分析显示，目前只有少数技术（RS、GIS、其他数字建模、AI相关和三维建模）是规划过程中的核心组成部分，而其他技术，如AI和数据技术，目前正在快速发展，已开始扩展其应用。机器学习（ML）和RS是增长最动态的技术，而新兴技术包括其他ICT、BIM、VR/AR/MR和社交媒体。最显著的相互关联是数据–RS–AI相关之间的关联。本研究的意义在于对景观规划中数字技术的全面绘制，为规划者、政策制定者和研究人员提供了宝贵的见解。主要结论表明，需要更多针对LP的技术的知识，包括理解并关联其在不同过程阶段的可行性和应用以及顺畅的整体工作流程。虽然我们的范围界定文献综述提供了关于LP过程中DT的全面信息，下一步是开发实用工具箱。

articles.title_en: A land use policy analysis method for natural hazard risk management across a regional single-family housing inventory
articles.title_cn: 一种面向区域单户住宅存量的自然灾害风险管理土地利用政策分析方法
articles.abstract_en: Managing a region’s natural hazard risk while also meeting demands for new development can be challenging. New development supports local governments’ tax revenues and other economic activities but may also lead to longer-term natural hazard losses if new construction is left unrestricted. Government entities commonly use land use policies to influence the location of new development. We developed a new land use policy analysis method that aims to assist planners and risk managers in disaster risk management by evaluating long-term housing development outcomes under different land use policy scenarios to reduce long-term natural hazard impacts. The computational method analyzes the spatial distribution of new housing, expected natural hazard losses, and property tax revenue impacts for a multidecadal projection period and multi-county region under alternative regional land use policy scenarios. While different risk management land use scenarios can be generated using this analysis method, we illustrate the method’s usefulness by comparing baseline housing development patterns with three disaster risk management land use policy scenarios in eastern North Carolina. These 30-year projections can inform planners and risk managers about how land use decisions can alter their region and their state’s vulnerabilities to natural hazard losses as well as the expected changes in property tax revenues.
articles.abstract_cn: 管理一个地区的自然灾害风险同时满足新开发需求可能具有挑战性。新开发支持地方政府的税收收入和其他经济活动，但如果新建设不受限制，也可能导致长期的自然灾害损失。政府实体通常使用土地利用政策来影响新开发的位置。我们开发了一种新的土地利用政策分析方法，旨在通过评估不同土地利用政策情景下的长期住房开发结果，协助规划者和风险管理者进行灾害风险管理，以减少长期自然灾害影响。该计算方法分析了在替代性区域土地利用政策情景下，多十年预测期和多县区域内新住房的空间分布、预期自然灾害损失和财产税收入影响。虽然可以使用这种分析方法生成不同的风险管理土地利用情景，但我们通过比较北卡罗来纳州东部的基线住房开发模式与三种灾害风险管理土地利用政策情景来说明该方法的实用性。这些30年预测可以告知规划者和风险管理者土地利用决策如何改变其地区和州对自然灾害损失的脆弱性，以及财产税收入的预期变化。

articles.title_en: Coupled impact of climate change and human activities on farmland loss on the Tibetan Plateau
articles.title_cn: 气候变化与人类活动对青藏高原耕地流失的耦合影响
articles.abstract_en: The Tibetan Plateau’s scarce farmland plays an important role in the livelihoods of its inhabitants. In the Yarlung Zangbo River Basin (YZRB), a key agricultural region on the plateau, the intricate natural environment and various human activities pose serious threats to the quantity and quality of farmland. Therefore, identifying the mechanisms behind farmland loss is essential to address these challenges effectively. Herein, we aimed to describe the spatial-temporal pattern of farmland change and assess the impact of natural and socioeconomic factors on farmland loss in the YZRB. We assessed the area of farmland loss based on the land use/land cover data with a resolution of 30 m. Given the diverse natural and socioeconomic environments within the YZRB, we employed geographically weighted logistic regression to explore the mechanisms of farmland loss across different ecogeographical regions. The findings revealed a steady decline in farmland area since 2000; significant farmland was lost to water and urban areas, while farmland replenished from grassland and forest was relatively minimal. The analysis highlighted the coupled impact of climate change and human activities on farmland loss in the main YZRB, particularly in agriculturally developed areas such as the shrub-steppe region. Socioeconomic development, administration, and policies influenced farmland loss in less agriculturally developed regions such as the alpine steppe, coniferous forest, and broadleaved forest regions. This research focuses on the critical issue of farmland loss in typical agricultural regions of the Tibetan Plateau and emphasizes the apparent spatial heterogeneity in the loss mechanisms, which could support the region-specific strategies in the management and decision-making of YZRB farmland.
articles.abstract_cn: 青藏高原稀缺的耕地对其居民的生计发挥着重要作用。在雅鲁藏布江流域（YZRB），作为高原上的关键农业区域，复杂的自然环境与多样的人类活动对耕地的数量和质量构成严重威胁。因此，识别耕地流失背后的机制对于有效应对这些挑战至关重要。在此，我们旨在描述雅鲁藏布江流域耕地变化的时空格局，并评估自然和社会经济因素对耕地流失的影响。我们基于分辨率为30米的土地利用/土地覆盖数据评估了耕地流失面积。鉴于雅鲁藏布江流域内多样的自然和社会经济环境，我们采用地理加权逻辑回归来探索不同生态地理区域中耕地流失的机制。研究结果显示，自2000年以来耕地面积持续下降；大量耕地流失为水域和城市区域，而从草地和森林补充的耕地相对较少。分析强调了气候变化与人类活动对雅鲁藏布江流域主要区域耕地流失的耦合影响，特别是在灌木草原区等农业发达地区。社会经济发展、行政管理和政策影响了高山草原、针叶林和阔叶林区等农业欠发达地区的耕地流失。本研究聚焦于青藏高原典型农业区耕地流失的关键问题，并强调了流失机制中明显的空间异质性，这可能为雅鲁藏布江流域耕地的管理和决策提供区域特定策略的支持。

articles.title_en: The role of farmer’s resources, capabilities and perceptions on reforestation and forest cover in the Atlantic Forest
articles.title_cn: 农民资源、能力与认知对大西洋森林再造林和森林覆盖的作用
articles.abstract_en: In the context of the UN Decade of Ecosystem Restoration (2021–2030), insights are urgently needed on how to engage land users in reforestation efforts. This study examined the resources, capabilities and perspectives of land users, i.e., farmers, in relation to reforestation in the Brazilian Atlantic Forest (BAF), an ecoregion that hosts 70 % of the Brazilian population while is also a biodiversity hotspot with only 28 % of native vegetation cover remaining. 78 % of the territory of this ecoregion is occupied by rural private properties, indicating the importance of on-farm forest restoration. We studied the pathways of how variation in forest cover can be explained by farmers’ perceptions of incentives, like pro-nature attitudes, and farmers’ resources and capabilities to engage in reforestation. Data were collected through a quantitative survey involving 257 farmers and their properties and forest cover derived from geo-spatial imagery. Using multiple regression models that underlie a path analysis, we found small and non-significant effects of both positive and negative perceptions of farmers on forest cover, but in combination with farmers’ resources and capabilities, these models could explain up to 36 % of variation on forest cover. The capability “slope”, as a proxy for production suitability, and the resource “farm size”, as a proxy for available capital, were always highly positively associated with forest cover in the models excluding and including farmers’ perceptions. These results highlight that reforestation decision making of farmers is complex and should be assessed accordingly, since it does not only regard the perceptions of the forest itself, but also the available resources and capabilities for restoration. Forest conservation and restoration initiatives can benefit from considering the variables assessed in this study; resources, capabilities, and perceptions of incentives and pro-nature motivation, while potential solutions, such as positive policy mechanisms, need to consider the heterogeneity of land and different types of landowners.
articles.abstract_cn: 在联合国生态系统恢复十年（2021-2030年）的背景下，迫切需要了解如何让土地使用者参与再造林工作的见解。本研究考察了巴西大西洋森林（BAF）中土地使用者（即农民）与再造林相关的资源、能力和观点，该生态区域居住着巴西70%的人口，同时也是一个生物多样性热点地区，仅剩28%的原生植被覆盖。该生态区域78%的领土为农村私人财产，表明农场内森林恢复的重要性。我们研究了森林覆盖变化如何由农民对激励措施的认知（如亲自然态度）以及农民参与再造林所需的资源和能力来解释的路径。数据通过涉及257名农民及其财产和来自地理空间影像的森林覆盖的定量调查收集。使用基于路径分析的多元回归模型，我们发现农民正面和负面认知对森林覆盖的影响小而显著，但与农民的资源和能力结合时，这些模型能解释森林覆盖变化的36%。能力“坡度”作为生产适宜性的代理，以及资源“农场规模”作为可用资本的代理，在排除和包含农民认知的模型中始终与森林覆盖高度正相关。这些结果强调，农民的再造林决策是复杂的，应相应评估，因为它不仅涉及对森林本身的认知，还涉及可用于恢复的资源和能力。森林保护和恢复倡议可以从考虑本研究中评估的变量中受益；资源、能力、对激励措施的认知和亲自然动机，而潜在的解决方案，如积极政策机制，需要考虑土地的异质性和不同类型的土地所有者。

articles.title_en: Optimizing global protected areas to address future land use threats to biodiversity
articles.title_cn: 优化全球保护区以应对未来土地利用对生物多样性的威胁
articles.abstract_en: Biodiversity faces heightened threats due to increasing global urbanization and land use intensity. Protecting global biodiversity through optimized protected areas is essential, yet current studies encounter challenges in measuring biodiversity, analyzing threat effects, and defining optimization pathways. We propose a framework to assess the impact of future land use changes on biodiversity in protected areas. By simulating biodiversity changes under different pathways, we evaluate the potential of protected areas in covering hotspots of natural habitats and biodiversity loss. Three scenarios (enhance protection management, optimize spatial distribution, improve global coverage) are compared to mitigate biodiversity loss. Our results found that future land use changes will lead to a decrease of 0.84 % and 0.97 % in richness and abundance. Compared to improving coverage, enhancing management and spatial optimization can also improve protection effectiveness. This study aids in identifying threats and optimizing pathways for global conservation efforts, advancing our understanding and capacity to address future conservation needs.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于全球城市化和土地利用强度的增加，生物多样性面临更严重的威胁。通过优化保护区来保护全球生物多样性至关重要，然而当前研究在衡量生物多样性、分析威胁效应和定义优化路径方面面临挑战。我们提出了一个框架来评估未来土地利用变化对保护区内生物多样性的影响。通过模拟不同路径下的生物多样性变化，我们评估了保护区在覆盖自然栖息地和生物多样性丧失热点方面的潜力。比较了三种情景（加强保护管理、优化空间分布、提高全球覆盖率）以减轻生物多样性丧失。我们的结果发现，未来土地利用变化将导致丰富度和多度分别下降0.84%和0.97%。与提高覆盖率相比，加强管理和空间优化也能提高保护效果。这项研究有助于识别威胁和优化全球保护工作的路径，增进我们对未来保护需求的理解和应对能力。

articles.title_en: Property rights, resource reallocation and welfare effects: Evidence from a land certification programme
articles.title_cn: 产权、资源重新配置与福利效应：来自土地确权项目的证据
articles.abstract_en: The paper finds that stronger property rights proxied by land certification reform result in resource reallocation and improve the welfare of rural households. Using the implementation of the land certification programme in China as a quasi-natural experiment, the study shows that households that obtained land certificates are 19 % more likely to rent out their agricultural land, 14 % more likely to allocate household workers to non-agricultural sectors and 13 % more likely to have migrant workers, which improves household income and consumption in rural China. In contrast, the study finds that the land reform did not affect household’s land renting-in, and the average cultivated area of rural households declines after the reform.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文发现，以土地确权改革为代表的更强产权保障促进了资源重新配置，并改善了农村家庭的福利。利用中国土地确权项目的实施作为准自然实验，研究表明，获得土地证书的家庭出租农地的可能性提高19%，将家庭劳动力配置到非农部门的可能性提高14%，拥有外出务工人员的可能性提高13%，从而改善了农村家庭的收入和消费。相反，研究发现土地改革并未影响家庭的土地转入，且改革后农村家庭的平均耕种面积有所下降。

articles.title_en: The transition towards carbon neutrality: Land use policy, resource and energy management modes, and spatial planning options
articles.title_cn: 迈向碳中和的转型：土地利用政策、资源与能源管理模式及空间规划选项
articles.abstract_en: This editorial paper synthesises the findings from the special issue dedicated to exploring the pivotal roles of land use policy, energy management, and spatial planning in achieving carbon neutrality. The eleven papers featured in this issue present innovative approaches and empirical studies that highlight crucial strategies for mitigating carbon emissions and promoting sustainable urban development. The papers in this issue explore topics ranging from the impact of urban centre layout on household carbon emissions in Chinese cities to the feasibility of 15-minute cities in the United States, and from the non-linear effects of land conveyance on urban carbon emissions to the simulations of land use carbon neutrality scenarios. Collectively, these studies provide a comprehensive overview of the complex relationships between urban form, land use, resource management, and carbon emissions. Furthermore, the issue advances our understanding of the pathways towards carbon neutrality, emphasising innovative spatial policies, governance, and implementation instruments that foster environmental and social co-benefits.
articles.abstract_cn: 这篇社论文章综合了特刊中的研究成果，该特刊旨在探讨土地利用政策、能源管理和空间规划在实现碳中和中的关键作用。本期收录的十一篇论文展示了创新方法和实证研究，突出了减缓碳排放和促进可持续城市发展的重要策略。本期论文探讨的主题涵盖从中国城市中心布局对家庭碳排放的影响到美国15分钟城市的可行性，从土地出让对城市碳排放的非线性效应到土地利用碳中和情景的模拟。总体而言，这些研究提供了对城市形态、土地利用、资源管理与碳排放之间复杂关系的全面概述。此外，本期还深化了我们对碳中和路径的理解，强调了促进环境和社会协同效益的创新空间政策、治理及实施工具。

articles.title_en: Unlocking opportunities for meaningful participation of land reform beneficiaries in the wildlife economy
articles.title_cn: 解锁土地改革受益者有意义参与野生动物经济的机会
articles.abstract_en: Land reform is a key social justice movement across the world, typically focused on agricultural land uses. However, in many parts of the world, land reform properties exist in regions that have high biodiversity value, where options exist for integrating land reform with wildlife-based land uses to promote both conservation and socio-economic development. To effectively design and implement policies aimed at unlocking this under-explored pathway towards inclusive wildlife economies, we need information on the opportunities and barriers confronting the establishment and operation of viable wildlife enterprises on redistributed land. We conducted a survey of 19 landholders awarded land through reform in the Eastern Cape Province of South Africa. We aimed to understand the state of wildlife economy development and assess investment needs for these market entrants. Their characteristics were contrasted with data on 74 established wildlife ranches and 21 conventional livestock farms. Despite all land reform properties listing wildlife-based economic activities in their business plans and most (84 %) having wildlife, only 42 % were generating (very limited) income from their wildlife. Common barriers to upscaling revenues from wildlife were a lack of infrastructure (particularly fencing, water, accommodation) and wildlife stocks. Engagement in the wildlife economy is further hindered by lack of decision-support on viable wildlife business models and subsequent lack of access to skills development and market information. Our results show mismatches between activities that are supported by government and property business plans, and those that are context-appropriate and viable. We suggest that South Africa’s land reform programmes need to develop targeted infrastructure and skills development that consider the most appropriate business model for a given site. The barriers and opportunities outlined here could inform strategies that leverage state and private investment to more effectively create viable wildlife-based business models and achieve the dual goals of social justice and biodiversity conservation in South Africa.
articles.abstract_cn: 土地改革是全球范围内一项关键的社会正义运动，通常侧重于农业土地利用。然而，在世界许多地方，土地改革地产位于具有高生物多样性价值的地区，在这些地区，存在将土地改革与基于野生动物的土地利用相结合以促进保护和经济社会发展的选择。为了有效设计和实施旨在解锁这条未被充分探索的通往包容性野生动物经济路径的政策，我们需要了解在重新分配土地上建立和运营可行野生动物企业所面临的机会和障碍。我们对南非东开普省通过改革获得土地的19名土地所有者进行了调查。我们旨在了解野生动物经济发展的状况，并评估这些市场进入者的投资需求。他们的特征与74个已建立的野生动物牧场和21个传统畜牧农场的数据进行了对比。尽管所有土地改革地产在其商业计划中都列出了基于野生动物的经济活动，且大多数（84%）拥有野生动物，但只有42%从野生动物中产生了（非常有限的）收入。扩大野生动物收入的主要障碍是缺乏基础设施（特别是围栏、水、住宿）和野生动物种群。参与野生动物经济还受到缺乏关于可行野生动物商业模式的决策支持以及随后缺乏技能发展和市场信息获取途径的阻碍。我们的结果显示，政府支持的活动和地产商业计划与那些符合情境且可行的活动之间存在不匹配。我们建议南非的土地改革计划需要发展有针对性的基础设施和技能发展，考虑特定场地最合适的商业模式。这里概述的障碍和机会可以为利用国家和私人投资更有效地创建可行的基于野生动物的商业模式，并在南非实现社会正义和生物多样性保护的双重目标的策略提供信息。

articles.title_en: Assessment of coupling coordination and spatial distribution characteristics between urbanization and ecosystem health in the Yellow River Basin
articles.title_cn: 黄河流域城市化与生态系统健康耦合协调及空间分布特征评估
articles.abstract_en: As an important ecological barrier and economic zone in China, the coordinated development of urbanization and the ecological system health of the Yellow River basin is crucial to the sustainable development of the region. Based on the data from 2000 to 2020, this study explores the interaction between urbanization and ecosystem health and its spatial distribution characteristics by using the coupled coordination degree model and spatial autocorrelation analysis methods. The results of the study indicate that: (1) from 2000 to 2020, The urbanization level in the Yellow River basin has increased significantly, with Progressive improvement in the ecosystem health index, The coupling coordination degree changes from "moderate imbalance" to "moderate equilibrium" stage; (2) Spatially, Coordination presents significant positive correlation features, Four forms of high-value cluster area, low-value heterogeneous area, low-value cluster area and high-value heterogeneous area in the western region, It reflects the regional differences between the urbanization process and the ecological health in the east and the west; (3) Land tenure and land use/restoration policies have an important impact on the neutral effect of land degradation, Clear land ownership and effective restoration measures can significantly improve the health level of ecosystems. This study provides a theoretical basis and decision-making reference for ecological protection and high-quality development in the Yellow River Basin. It is suggested that the coordinated development of urbanization and ecological health should be realized by urbanization construction, optimization of ecological restoration policies, and regional collaborative governance according to local conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为中国重要的生态屏障和经济区，黄河流域城市化与生态系统健康的协调发展对该区域的可持续发展至关重要。基于2000年至2020年的数据，本研究利用耦合协调度模型和空间自相关分析方法，探讨了城市化与生态系统健康之间的相互作用及其空间分布特征。研究结果表明：（1）从2000年到2020年，黄河流域城市化水平显著提高，生态系统健康指数逐步改善，耦合协调度从“中度失调”阶段转变为“中度协调”阶段；（2）在空间上，协调性呈现显著的正相关特征，西部地区存在高值集聚区、低值异质区、低值集聚区和高值异质区四种形式，反映了东西部城市化进程与生态健康之间的区域差异；（3）土地权属和土地利用/恢复政策对土地退化的中性效应具有重要影响，明确的土地所有权和有效的恢复措施能够显著提高生态系统的健康水平。本研究为黄河流域的生态保护和高质量发展提供了理论依据和决策参考。建议通过因地制宜的城市化建设、优化生态恢复政策以及区域协同治理，实现城市化与生态健康的协调发展。

articles.title_en: Conflict in land acquisition for cooperative housing development in Woldia, Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 埃塞俄比亚沃尔迪亚合作住房开发中土地征用冲突
articles.abstract_en: Land acquisition conflicts pose a significant obstacle to the socio-economic development of any country if not managed effectively. These conflicts can be addressed through the appropriate application of various conflict resolution mechanisms. This study therefore aims to examine conflict in land acquisition for cooperative housing development in Woldia, Ethiopia. Data were gathered from 323 displaced farmers, six focus group discussions (FGDs), and 25 key informant interviews (KIIs). Descriptive statistics, chi-square test and spearman correlation were used to analyze the collected data. The results of the study revealed that the factors driving conflicts were inadequate compensation, loss of livelihood, poor law implementation, unfair land acquisition procedures, and dissatisfaction with valuation. Conflicts were resolved through indigenous conflict resolution methods, modern litigation techniques, and a combination of both. There is a significant association between land acquisition conflict resolution methods with their acceptance level (χ2 = 49.24, N = 96, P = 0.000) and satisfaction level (χ2 = 59.68, N = 96, P = 0.000). There was also a strong positive correlation between the acceptance level and the level of satisfaction with the conflict resolution method, which was statistically significant (rs=0.867, p = .0000). To effectively manage conflicts, the government should strengthen public-private partnerships (PPPs), adopt a win-win- approach, and improve compensation systems to effectively manage conflicts. Decision-makers can develop and implement efficient conflict management strategies that facilitate the successful acquisition of land and the development of cooperative housing.
articles.abstract_cn: 土地征用冲突若管理不当，会对任何国家的社会经济发展构成重大障碍。这些冲突可以通过适当运用各种冲突解决机制来加以解决。因此，本研究旨在考察埃塞俄比亚沃尔迪亚合作住房开发中的土地征用冲突。数据收集自323名被迁移农民、六次焦点小组讨论（FGDs）和25名关键知情人访谈（KIIs）。采用描述性统计、卡方检验和斯皮尔曼相关分析对收集的数据进行分析。研究结果显示，引发冲突的因素包括补偿不足、生计丧失、法律执行不力、土地征用程序不公以及对估价的不满。冲突通过本土冲突解决方法、现代诉讼技术以及两者结合的方式得以解决。土地征用冲突解决方法与其接受水平（χ2 = 49.24，N = 96，P = 0.000）和满意度水平（χ2 = 59.68，N = 96，P = 0.000）之间存在显著关联。接受水平与冲突解决方法满意度之间也存在强正相关，且具有统计显著性（rs=0.867，p = .0000）。为有效管理冲突，政府应加强公私合作伙伴关系（PPPs），采取双赢方法，并改进补偿体系以有效管理冲突。决策者可以制定并实施高效的冲突管理策略，以促进土地的成功征用和合作住房的开发。

articles.title_en: Unhiding the “land rights” and “land wrongs” in sub-Saharan Africa: An interpretive scoping review
articles.title_cn: 揭示撒哈拉以南非洲的“土地权利”与“土地错误”：一项解释性范围综述
articles.abstract_en: Various scholars have shown that improving land tenure security is essential for development by asserting that they are preconditions for improving societal well-being. This has led to initiating programmes envisaged to strengthen land tenure security in sub-Saharan Africa, though their outcomes remain under-researched. This study presents a foundational understanding of why improvements in land tenure security, though valuable, can also lead to adverse consequences in SSA. We used ‘land rights’ to represent valuable outcomes and ‘land wrongs’ to denote adverse ones. Based on a scoping review, this review article probed two questions: What positive and negative outcomes have emerged from land tenure security interventions in sub-Saharan Africa, and how can the adverse outcomes be improved? The review is based on fifty-seven (n = 57) peer-reviewed studies identified via direct Google Scholar search and snowballed expert recommendations. With the identified land wrongs in some land tenure security interventions, the study concludes that not all tenure improvement programmes are suitable and promising for SSA. The imbalance in implementation to benefit people, places, and livelihood activities was the primary cause of most land wrongs. However, improving tenure in ways that enhance these three elements guarantees genuine tenure improvements. The study presents a framework for securing land tenure to prevent land wrong outcomes and guide towards ensuring their intended outcomes. The review will be helpful for land policymakers seeking to understand the nature and value of improving land tenure security and researchers seeking directives and directions for further studies.
articles.abstract_cn: 众多学者表明，改善土地权属保障对发展至关重要，并断言这是改善社会福祉的前提条件。这促使启动了旨在加强撒哈拉以南非洲土地权属保障的项目，尽管其结果仍未得到充分研究。本研究提供了对为何改善土地权属保障虽有价值但也可能在撒哈拉以南非洲导致不利后果的基础性理解。我们用“土地权利”代表有价值的成果，用“土地错误”表示不利后果。基于范围综述，本文探讨了两个问题：撒哈拉以南非洲的土地权属保障干预产生了哪些积极和消极结果，以及如何改善不利结果？本综述基于通过直接谷歌学术搜索和滚雪球式专家推荐确定的五十七（n = 57）篇同行评审研究。鉴于某些土地权属保障干预中发现的土地错误，研究得出结论，并非所有权属改善项目都适合且有前景于撒哈拉以南非洲。实施中在惠及人民、地方和生计活动方面的不平衡是大多数土地错误的主要原因。然而，以增强这三个要素的方式改善权属可确保真正的权属改善。本研究提出了一个保障土地权属的框架，以防止土地错误结果并指导确保其预期成果。本综述将有助于寻求理解改善土地权属保障的性质和价值的土地政策制定者，以及寻求进一步研究方向和指导的研究人员。

articles.title_en: Conservation easement adoption among forest landowners in the United States
articles.title_cn: 美国林地所有者中保护地役权的采用
articles.abstract_en: Conservation easements have become a prevalent method for conserving forestland in the United States in the face of housing and other development. In this study, we used data from the National Woodland Owner Survey conducted by the USDA Forest Service in 2017–2018 to examine patterns and determinants of conservation easement adoption on individual forestland parcels. A total of 9349 landowners are included in the analysis, covering all 50 states. We used a spatial binary probit model to consider potential spatial dependence in conservation decisions among adjacent landowners. Our results reveal that significant spatial dependence exists, suggesting that about 30 % of the total effect of an explanatory variable on easement adoption comes from an indirect spatial effect. Landowners' degree of awareness of conservation easements has the most significant positive effect. Easement adoption is also higher among landowners possessing non-commodity ownership objectives, such as wildlife protection, while adoption is lower among landowners with primarily timber and investment objectives. Demand for conserving forestland has increased in areas experiencing more remarkable population growth or household income. States adopting statutory conservation easement laws earlier tend to have higher rates of easement adoption. Policy implications of these findings are discussed for conservation entities and government agencies to promote conservation easements in the future.
articles.abstract_cn: 面对住房及其他开发压力，保护地役权已成为美国保护林地的一种普遍方法。本研究利用美国农业部林务局在2017-2018年进行的全国林地所有者调查数据，考察了单个林地地块上保护地役权采用的模式及决定因素。分析共纳入9349名土地所有者，覆盖所有50个州。我们采用空间二元概率模型来考虑相邻土地所有者之间保护决策中潜在的空间依赖性。结果显示存在显著的空间依赖性，表明解释变量对地役权采用的总效应中约有30%来自间接空间效应。土地所有者对保护地役权的认知程度具有最显著的正向影响。在拥有非商品性所有权目标（如野生动物保护）的土地所有者中，地役权采用率也较高，而在以木材和投资为主要目标的土地所有者中，采用率较低。在人口增长或家庭收入增长更为显著的地区，对林地保护的需求有所增加。较早采用法定保护地役权法律的州往往具有较高的地役权采用率。本文讨论了这些发现对保护实体和政府机构未来推广保护地役权的政策启示。

articles.title_en: Decoding the formation mechanisms of rural settlements expansion patterns in transitional China
articles.title_cn: 转型期中国农村居民点扩展格局的形成机制解析
articles.abstract_en: In recent decades, the rural settlements (RSs) in China have experienced a remarkable process of differentiation and restructuring during the stages of urban expansion, urban transformation, and coordinated urban-rural development. As an important part of urban-rural integrated development, the quantitative transformation and landscape dynamics of RSs are crucial for optimizing RSs and implementing the national rural revitalization strategy. However, there is still a lack of research on the characteristics and evolutionary mechanisms of landscape patterns of RSs in China. To fill the gap, this study employed land use datasets from 1980 to 2020 to investigate the formation mechanisms of the landscape pattern for RSs in China, utilizing multiple statistical analysis models. The findings revealed a gradual increase in RSs, predominantly resulting from the conversion of cultivated land. During the study period, the overall landscape pattern indices for RSs exhibited an overall increasing trend. The regions exhibiting the high values of patch density and percentage of landscape were predominantly situated within the Huang-Huai-Hai plain. The regions exhibiting the high values of the landscape shape index were primarily concentrated in the Huang-Huai-Hai plain and the Northeast China plain. The counties exhibiting a low agglomeration index were predominantly situated in the middle-lower Yangtze plain. Hotspot analysis revealed that RSs in Huang-Huai-Hai plain exhibited a more pronounced trend of fragmentation during the study period. The Geodetector model revealed that nighttime lighting, land use intensity, slope, elevation, population density, and precipitation were the determining factors in the formation of RSs. Geographically weighted regression model demonstrated significant spatial heterogeneity in the effects of these factors. This study contributed to the formulation of settlement development strategies, the optimization of RSs layouts, and the promotion of rural revitalization.
articles.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，中国农村居民点（RSs）在城市扩张、城市转型和城乡协调发展阶段经历了显著的分化和重构过程。作为城乡一体化发展的重要组成部分，农村居民点的数量转变和景观动态对于优化农村居民点和实施国家乡村振兴战略至关重要。然而，关于中国农村居民点景观格局特征及其演化机制的研究仍然缺乏。为填补这一空白，本研究利用1980年至2020年的土地利用数据集，运用多种统计分析模型，探讨了中国农村居民点景观格局的形成机制。研究结果显示，农村居民点面积逐渐增加，主要来源于耕地的转化。在研究期间，农村居民点的整体景观格局指数呈现总体上升趋势。斑块密度和景观面积百分比高值区域主要位于黄淮海平原。景观形状指数高值区域主要集中在黄淮海平原和东北平原。聚集指数低的县域主要位于长江中下游平原。热点分析显示，研究期间黄淮海平原的农村居民点破碎化趋势更为明显。地理探测器模型揭示，夜间灯光、土地利用强度、坡度、海拔、人口密度和降水是农村居民点形成的主要决定因素。地理加权回归模型显示这些因素的影响存在显著的空间异质性。本研究有助于制定居民点发展战略、优化农村居民点布局和促进乡村振兴。

excluded_items.title_en: Corrigendum to “Factors influencing people’s knowledge, attitude, and practice in land use dynamics: A case study in Ca Mau province in the Mekong delta, Vietnam” [Land Use Policy 72 (2018) 227–238]
